title: In-app application update download and install
description: Make app-release notifications actionable: reliable View Release with sanitized external URL launching, plus one-click download, checksum verification and install for AppImage, .deb and the Windows installer.
notes: Archived 2026-10-29 after the feature merged as PR #37 and shipped in v2.15.0. Regression coverage lives in tests/test_app_update_service.py, tests/test_external_url.py, tests/test_release_check_service.py and tests/ui/test_ui_update_flow.py on main.
